l.i: TE, Sancte Patris Spiritus, invoco Natiq; supplex. Da facilesque precor Sonare versus. Da placidus lyra Tristes decenti dicere nanias Fletusq; logos: queis male creditus Isacidarum plebibus, obrutas Syonis arces cladibus asperis Rigauit olim, & funera patria, Mystes verendus: quum Solymam tuis Iussis rebellem sub iuga barbarus Victor coegit: quum decus aureum, Ingensq; templi gloria corruit, Et sacra diris Rex Babylonius Euertit atrox ignibus atria.
Maiora posco (namque potes dare Petita veris cordibus omnia) Concede lucis perpetuum tuae Splendere nostris pectoribus iubar: Ut scripta divis carmina vatibus

page.notes: The large initial is an ornamented woodcut T, joined to "E," as "TE,". The decorative border and small ornament below the heading are not transcribed. Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible at the top and right and is left out. The running head is not printed on this page. Long s is written as plain s throughout. The printed "Natiq;" and "Fletusq;" contractions are kept as printed; the macron on "lōgos" is copied from the scan. The stanza break after "atria." is taken from the indent before "Maiora posco". No doubtful readings.
